debrief db-021
1) the ac-tor m-e-r-g-e-d the p-r-o-f-i-l-e f-i-l-e-s into a s-i-n-g-l-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y f-o-l-d-e-r and l-e-f-t a c-o-m-b-i-n-e-d b-i-o file w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-o-u-r-c-e a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w
2) the ac-tor c-r-e-a-t-e-d a n-u-m-b-e-r of p-e-r-s-o-n-a l message t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s and l-e-f-t a s-t-a-t-i-s-t-i-c s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e d-r-a-f-t in the out-box while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
3) the ac-tor i-n-s-t-r-u-m-e-n-t-e-d the f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s with e-m-o-t-i-o-n-a-l s-o-f-t-eners and l-e-f-t a s-c-r-i-p-ted s-c-r-i-p-t f-o-r r-e-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-r-a-u-d d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e a-u-d-i-t
4) the ac-tor c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d the m-u-l-e re-cru-i-t-m-e-n-t via a c-h-a-i-n of i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y s-w-a-p-s and l-e-f-t a r-o-u-t-i-n-g l-i-s-t of a-c-c-o-u-n-t s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-c-y s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l
5) the ac-tor i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d a s-h-a-d-o-w c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n p-a-t-h to b-l-o-c-k v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n and l-e-f-t a b-l-a-c-k-l-i-s-t of c-o-n-t-a-c-t s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-r n-e-t-w-o-r-k r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g d-u-t-y c-h-e-c-k
